en: {rival}'s Sister
Hi, {player}!
{rival}
Hey! Got yourself a Pokémon yet? There's nobody to battle round here. I'm bored out of my mind!
...Wait. A girl called Bianca is coming to give you one? Seriously?!
{rival}'s Sister
{player}... when you get your Pokémon, be really, really kind to it. OK?
{rival}
...Yeah.
Right! There's something I have to do, and I can't do it alone. I need someone I can trust.
Besides my partner, I mean. Someone like you. So let's go find this Bianca!
Head home, sis.
{rival}'s Sister
OK, big brother! Bye-bye, {player}!
{rival}
I'll check the Pokémon Center and the school. You look round the rest of town. Whoever finds her first, shouts!
{player} hasn't found Bianca yet. Better look round Aspertia before heading out of town.
{rival}
{player}! Hang on!
She wasn't at the Center, or the school. Then it hit me. The outlook! It's the best-known spot in town.
Anyone new to Aspertia goes up there first. Go on, get up there and get your Pokémon! I'll wait here.
{rival}
Hey, wrong way! I'm telling you, she's up there. Go and get your Pokémon!
Bianca
It's sooo pretty up here. I could look at this view all day!
Wow... It's sooo pretty! You can see all the way to the sea from here.
Oh! Hi there! Isn't this view something?
Bianca
I'm Bianca! I help Professor Juniper with her Pokémon research.
I'm looking for someone, actually. Do you know a Trainer called {player}?
No? Hmm. They told me what to look for... Wait a sec. That's you, isn't it!
You do? Oh! Wait, it's you! You're {player}!
Wooow, you're exactly like they told me!
I've got a really important favour to ask. Will you help us complete the Pokédex?
N-no way. I must have heard that wrong. This is really, really important, you know!
Yay, thank you! Your help is going to move the professor's research along so much.
And filling in the Pokédex is super fun, I promise! OK then... ta-daaa!
One of the Pokémon in here is going to be your partner. Go on, choose!
{player} chose {starter}!
Oh, wow! You and {starter} look perfect together!
Now you've got a Pokémon, you get this too. Your very own Pokédex!
{player} received the Pokédex!
It notes down every Pokémon you meet, all by itself. The professor wants you to see as many as you can!
{rival}
Heeey! How long were you going to leave me waiting down there?!
So that's your partner? Nice! Like my sister said: look after it really, really well. Got it?
Hey... what's that you're holding?
Bianca
It's a Pokédex!
{rival}
Give me one too! Please! I want to get stronger, and if I know more about Pokémon, I'll be tougher. Right?
Bianca
Um... sorry, who are you again?
{rival}
I'm {rival}! I'm going to travel all over Unova with my partner. I'm looking for something really important.
Bianca
Well, OK! I don't totally get it, but a journey's always a good idea. And I just happen to have a spare!
Bianca gave {rival} a Pokédex.
Ooh, I've had a brilliant idea! You've both got Pokémon now. Why don't you have a battle?
{rival}
Yeah! Let's see what kind of Trainer you are. I'll use the {rivalstarter} I raised from an Egg!
{rival}
I lost... Battling a Trainer is nothing like battling wild Pokémon!
Whatever. Now I know you're a Trainer I can count on, and that's what matters.
Not bad at all for your first battle!
Right, I'm heading off first. Get stronger, OK?
Bianca
Both your Pokémon tried so hard! But your partner's still small, so battle a lot and help it grow.
Now let's get it fixed up at the Pokémon Center. It's the best place ever for Pokémon tired out from battling!
Mom
Oh! You must be Bianca. Nice to meet you! And {player} has chosen {starter}. Don't they look good together?
Oh, I nearly forgot! Here, take these. They're Running Shoes!
{player} received a pair of Running Shoes!
A perfect fit! Hold the run button down and you'll go faster than ever. Off you go, run to your heart's content!
{rival}'s Sister
Um... and these are from me!
Bianca
Huh? Why are there two Town Maps?
{rival}'s Sister
The other one's for my big brother. He ran off without one! Will you give it to him, {player}?
{player} put {rival}'s Town Map away to give him later.
Mom
What a lovely idea. Even when there's only one road down to the sea, a Town Map is good to have.
Bianca
Aww, you guys! Just watching this makes me happy!
OK, next stop: Route 19! I'll show you how to catch a Pokémon. Come find me past the gate!
Mom
Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.
Bianca
Heeey!
How did it go with the Gym Leader? Oh! Is that the Basic Badge? Amazing!
You only just set out, and you've already won a Badge! Here, take this to celebrate.
It holds Return. The closer a Pokémon is to its Trainer, the harder that move hits!
Still, Cheren...
Cheren
Bianca! It's been two years, hasn't it?
Bianca
Cheren! Wow, look at you. A real Gym Leader!
Cheren
{player}, Bianca and I set out on our own journeys from Nuvema Town, far to the east of here.
If you ever want to talk about types or Abilities, ask me. I'm a teacher now, after all.
{rival}
Hey! You there!
Are you the Gym Leader? One, two, three, let's battle!
Cheren
You look like a tough Trainer. Very well. Come into my Gym.
{rival}
That's it? What kind of answer is that?! I'm taking you down!
Bianca
Being a Gym Leader is even harder than I thought...
Anyway! The next Gym is in Virbank City, east along Route 20 past Floccesy Town. Good luck, {player}!
{rival}
Bianca, Bianca... where could she be?
She's up at the outlook, I'm sure of it. Go on!
Mom
Have a wonderful trip! Go and see all the Pokémon and people you can, with your own eyes.
{rival}'s Sister
Be good friends with your Pokémon, OK?
Cheren
A Trainer who knows why they battle grows faster. Think about what you want from your journey.
